# Linker messages the macOS link jobs of shipped-targets.yml let through.
#
# One entry per line: a spyc issue number, then a Python regex searched in the
# message's first line as the job summary prints it (paths and hashes
# stripped). An entry without an issue number fails the job. Delete the entry
# when its issue closes. CONTRIBUTING.md has the procedure.
#
# For example, the duplicate `memset` of #1129 would read:
# 1129 ld: duplicate symbol '_memset'
